description: This file defines the RssItem class, a simple data structure to hold properties of an RSS feed item such as title, link, and description. It includes constructors, getters, and setters for these properties.

classes.name: RssItem
classes.description: A class representing a single RSS feed item with title, link, and description fields.

methods.name: RssItem()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing title, link, and description to empty strings.

methods.name: RssItem(CharSequence, CharSequence, CharSequence)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the RSS item with specific title, link, and description.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the RSS item.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the RSS item.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the link of the RSS item.

methods.name: setLink
methods.description: Sets the link of the RSS item.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the RSS item.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the RSS item.
